title: Shenzhen Ysstech Info-Tech Exits Ningbo Shangwen Technology with 25 Million Yuan Sale
Shenzhen Ysstech Info-Tech cède sa participation dans Ningbo Shangwen Technology pour 25 millions de yuans
Jiangxi Ouchuang Technology Co., Ltd. completed the acquisition of 8.18% stake in Ningbo Sanan Investment Holdings Co., Ltd. from Shenzhen Ysstech Info-Tech Co.,Ltd.
